title: AI Blueprint
description: Transforms the photo into a detailed architectural blueprint-style illustration.
positive_prompt: Transform the input photo into a detailed architectural blueprint-style illustration. Reconstruct all visible subjects, clothing, props, and environmental elements as precise technical line drawings on a deep navy-blue background. Use fine white and cyan outlines, delicate construction lines, contour tracing, subtle geometric guides, and controlled line-weight variation. Suggest dimensional structure through clean wireframe contours and selective cross-hatching while preserving the original perspective. Render people as recognizable technical illustrations, retaining distinctive face shapes, hairstyles, body proportions, poses, and clothing structures. Rendering contract: Use the input image as visual ground truth. Treat the input photo as the definitive reference. Keep the exact number of subjects and their left-to-right order, relative scale, pose, gaze, interaction, perspective, proportions, framing, and key props. For every visible person, retain recognizable face geometry, distinguishing landmarks, and facial features through linework rather than realistic color or shading; do not beautify, age, or swap identity unless explicitly requested. Translate original colors into blueprint line hierarchy without changing object identities. Preserve the source aspect ratio, camera viewpoint, and all important content inside the frame. Apply the transformation consistently across every part of the scene, subjects, clothing, props, and environment. Return one coherent finished image, not a before-and-after comparison, split screen, or unintended collage; output one complete static technical illustration without readable annotations, measurements, letters, numerals, numbers, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, or interface elements.
negative_prompt: photorealistic colors, realistic shading, full-color objects, oil painting, messy sketching, illegible scribbles, thick random strokes, excessive grid overlays, technical labels, dimensions, numbers, text, captions, logos, watermarks, altered proportions, incorrect perspective, changed identity, missing people, additional subjects, malformed anatomy, duplicate outlines, broken facial structure, unrecognizable silhouettes, collage, identity drift, face swap, altered age, altered skin tone, wrong subject count, extra people, duplicated subject, merged subjects, inconsistent transformation, partial transformation, before-and-after, split screen, unintended collage, accidental crop, cut-off face, broken hands, fused fingers, extra limbs, incoherent perspective, floating objects, random text, gibberish letters, numerals, signature, interface elements
custom_prompt_placeholder: e.g. cyan lines, technical schematic, navy background...
